basics.name: John Walley
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 20+ years of experience building developer-facing applications, libraries, and tools across frontend, backend, and infrastructure. Deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, API design, and browser engineering, with a track record of creating reusable abstractions that reduce complexity and improve developer productivity. Experienced leading technical direction and delivering complex systems end-to-end, from architecture and implementation through testing, deployment, and production. Combines hands-on engineering depth with product thinking and cross-functional technical leadership.

work.name: Cambridge Intelligence
work.summary: Senior engineer working across developer experience, web applications, tooling, and high-performance visualisation products, with a focus on architecture, developer productivity, and technical direction.
highlights: Helped design and deliver a unified developer platform for multiple SDK products, reducing duplication and simplifying how documentation, examples, and developer tooling are developed and maintained.
Designed developer-facing APIs and reusable abstractions that reduced complexity for developers integrating and extending data visualisation products.
Worked with the Platform team to transfer ownership of Cloudflare-hosted website infrastructure to the development team, reducing cross-team dependencies and enabling faster, more reliable delivery.
Worked with QA to expand Playwright end-to-end testing to cover approximately 90% of unauthenticated website functionality, increasing confidence in releases.
Helped shape technical priorities and architectural decisions across application architecture, testing, developer experience, infrastructure, and engineering workflows.

Applied AI-assisted engineering workflows across debugging, architectural analysis, code review, and content migration, accelerating diagnosis of complex issues and reducing effort on repetitive engineering tasks.

work.name: Mulberry House Software
work.summary: Founded and led a consultancy building data-driven applications and developer tooling, remaining hands-on across architecture, implementation, infrastructure, and product direction.
highlights: Created and maintained reusable open-source React UI and data visualisation libraries, including [Allotment](https://allotment.mulberryhousesoftware.com/) and [Pennant](https://pennant.vega.xyz/), with 200,000+ weekly downloads and production use by the [Vega](https://vega.xyz/) trading network.
Designed and delivered full-stack applications and developer-facing tools across multiple industries, owning projects end-to-end from initial requirements through production.
Built and deployed production systems spanning browser applications, Node.js APIs, cloud infrastructure, build tooling, and deployment pipelines.

Delivered interactive applications and data visualisation tools for clients including home-renovation startup [Reno](https://www.renovatewithreno.co.uk/) and pensions technology company [Financial Canvas](https://www.financialcanvas.co.uk/).
Led technical delivery while growing a consultancy, combining hands-on engineering with architecture, client collaboration, prioritisation, and product decisions.

work.name: Redgate
highlights: Improved adoption and usability of a database deployment tool used in CI/CD pipelines through product and UX improvements.
Introduced in-product analytics to support data-driven product decisions and prioritisation.
Worked closely with users, UX, and engineering to identify problems, gather feedback, and define and prioritise features.

work.name: Redgate
work.summary: Developed developer-facing tooling to streamline SQL Server database deployment within release pipelines.
highlights: Built tools and features that improved the reliability and usability of database deployment workflows in production environments.

work.name: Sungard
highlights: Contributed to a scalable framework powering high-performance financial risk analytics.
Developed a tracing JIT compiler enabling C# financial models to execute efficiently on GPUs.

work.name: Earlier Career
work.summary: Held engineering and research roles spanning financial services, high-performance computing, scientific computing, and developer tooling.
highlights: High Performance Computing Developer at Fidelity, working on computationally intensive systems in financial services.
Application Engineer at MathWorks, acting as UK technical contact for parallel computing tools and helping developers solve complex computational problems.
Research Scientist at QinetiQ, working on multi-sensor fusion, object tracking, and defence systems.
